issues.issue: Whether the threats from the husband's family are linked to a Convention ground (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Claimants fear harm and extortion from the husband's family, who want money, if returned to China.
issues.result_text: Claimants are not persecuted for a Convention ground; fears relate to extortion, not gender or domestic violence.

issues.issue: Whether the threats are genuine and likely to be acted upon
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says the husband's family threatened harm and sought their address after they arrived in Canada.
issues.result_text: Claimants lacked subjective fear; they did not disclose fear in the H&C application despite legal advice.

issues.issue: Whether state protection is available in China
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says PSB officers in the husband's family would help locate them, so police protection is not available.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not rebut the presumption of state protection; state protection is available in China.
